## pluralise {#symbol-function-pluralise}

```{.ts filename="TypeScript"}
function pluralise(
   count,
   singular,
   plural?
): string;
```

Defined in: [packages/core/src/pluralise.ts:9](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-wizard/blob/2b7aeb007c7b0fe072983205ddf5e1ebf8a97ac6/packages/core/src/pluralise.ts#L9)

Writes a count with its noun, in the singular for one and in the plural otherwise.

### Parameters

| Parameter  | Type     | Description                                                        |
| ---------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `count`    | `number` | The number of items.                                               |
| `singular` | `string` | The noun for one item.                                             |
| `plural?`  | `string` | The noun for any other count, the singular with an `s` by default. |

### Returns

`string`

The count and the noun, for example `2 extensions`.
